purpose: real-H&E rotation noise-floor + oracle-vs-anatomy calibration, feeding results_v2/phase2/preregistered_thresholds.json
split_replication: test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=label -- identical parameters to code/data_prep.py::build_patch_dataset; train/test membership itself is untouched, calibration only selects a deterministic sub-list of TRAIN images

calibration_subset.selection_rule: first 20 train-split images sorted by filename stem

sign_convention_bug_found_and_fixed_duri.description: initial calibration script used sk_rotate(angle=+alpha) for the oracle rotation-floor check, copied from Phase 1R's MODEL-specific convention; empirical verification showed the structure-tensor ORACLE needs sk_rotate(angle=-alpha) instead (opposite sign, matching the ORIGINAL Phase 1 pilot's stripe-test convention, not Phase 1R's escnn-model convention)
sign_convention_bug_found_and_fixed_duri.evidence: for a synthetic test object, sk_rotate(angle=-alpha) recovered phi0+alpha to within ~1 deg for alpha in {20,45,70} deg; sk_rotate(angle=+alpha) did not (errors of 30-95 deg)
sign_convention_bug_found_and_fixed_duri.classification: LEVEL 1 implementation bug per master-prompt change-control taxonomy -- fixed and retested before any threshold was frozen; no scientific design was altered
